'''Tunrothese''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Tunroth]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Jiroch-Reslia]], the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Jiroch system/Legends|Jiroch system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The language was spoken in simple vocalizations, grunts, and snarls, and was thought of as primitive sounding. When in [[Writing/Legends|written]] form, Tunrothese was drawn as pictograms portraying physical objects. Ordinary Tunroth had the ability to both read and write Tunrothese.<ref name="UAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tunrothese was mentioned in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="UAA" />
